data.title: Popover
data.tagline: Open a small panel with extra information or controls
data.description: A popover is anchored to a trigger and can contain richer content than a tooltip, such as a preview, explanation, or a few controls. It should not carry a long workflow, and its opening and closing behavior must work with keyboard and touch input.

avoid: Put essential information only behind hover
Build a long form inside a small floating panel
Open it without a clear anchor
Let it cover the control needed to close it

lessonPractice.title: In a member list, clicking an avatar should reveal department, email, and two quick actions in place, including on mobile. What fits best?

options.label: Use a popover opened by click or focus, anchored to the avatar with working actions inside
options.feedback: The content is richer than a hint but still lightweight. A popover preserves context and supports keyboard and touch.

options.label: Use a text tooltip that appears only on hover and put the two actions inside it
options.feedback: Tooltips do not suit multiple details and interactive actions, and touch devices have no reliable hover entry.

options.label: Open a profile modal that occupies most of the screen whenever the avatar is clicked
options.feedback: A modal can hold the content but is too heavy for a few details and two shortcuts, interrupting list browsing.

data.agentPrompt: Open a member popover from avatar click and keyboard focus. Anchor it to the trigger and include department, email, and two actionable controls. Support touch, Escape, outside-click dismissal, and pointer movement into the popover.
